This is the Customer Stories landing page for Eightfold, an AI-powered talent intelligence platform. The page serves as a hub showcasing how leading organizations transform their workforces using Eightfold's solutions.
Company Description: Eightfold positions itself as "the agentic talent intelligence company that gives every HR leader, recruiter, and people manager the intelligence to see, develop, and deploy the full depth of talent around them."
Main Products Featured: Talent Agents (including AI Interviewer and AI Interview Companion); Talent Intelligence platform; Talent Acquisition, Management, and Resource Management tools; TalentForge
Notable Achievement: One specific customer example mentioned is STMicroelectronics, which reportedly saved "160+ hours in 2 months" through scaled hiring using Eightfold's platform.
Certifications & Awards: The page displays multiple security and industry recognitions including SOC 2 Type II, ISO 42001, and recognition as a 2026 Strategic Leader and Top HR Product.
Notable Metric: Another case study references "30% faster time-to-fill" achieved by a customer.
